owner_proposal: Usage examples at the end of help, analogous to man pages; revisited after the assistant had argued against the idea.

conditions.A: Current help, guides and schemas unchanged
conditions.B: Add only help-recipe.txt to root long help; retain guides and schemas

decision_rule.correctness: No treatment critical failures or incomplete runs and no lower pass count than control on any case.
decision_rule.configuration_benefit: For each of tasks 3 and 8: either median agent calls at least 1 lower with median uncached input no more than 5% higher, or median uncached input at least 10% lower with median agent calls no higher. The improved metric must favor treatment in at least 3 of 4 pairs for that case.
decision_rule.unrelated_cost: Task 1 median agent calls no higher and median uncached input no more than 5% higher.
decision_rule.secondary_metrics: Always report cached input, output including reasoning, shell/CLI calls, guide/schema retrievals and completion time; a material regression in these prevents unqualified adoption.
decision_rule.interpretation: Practical diagnostic thresholds, not statistical significance. Failure to meet them means no demonstrated adoption benefit for this exact recipe; it does not reject usage examples generally.
decision_rule.product_change: This experiment does not install the treatment into production.

integrity: Freeze prompts, fixtures, treatment, harness and grading rules before launch. Exclude invalid instrumentation/context sessions explicitly; retain valid failures and their costs.
review: Independently review final answers with condition/cost labels concealed; answers may reveal their route.
